name: Installation Manual
description: PRESCRIPTIVE document: tells the installer what to do, which no source document contains. Reference implementation of the prescriptive rules (WORKORDER_0.27 §B): all facts inside steps stay cited (depths, capacities, standards, requirements), while the SEQUENCE is AI-drafted, visibly badged 'AI-foreslått rekkefølge', and closed with author placeholders. A mandatory section lists what only the manufacturer's manual can supply. Used for installation, commissioning, and site-work documents across trades and engineering.

sections.title: System Overview
sections.notes: What the installation consists of and how the parts relate — compiled from cited facts. Natural home for a connection_spec block diagram (WORKORDER_0.24) when one exists.

sections.title: Prerequisites & Requirements
sections.notes: Permit conditions, regulatory limits, site constraints, required approvals — all cited. This is the section that makes the manual project-specific rather than generic: e.g. discharge depth minimums, treatment percentages, ground conditions, access restrictions.

sections.title: Safety & Site Hazards
sections.notes: Hazards from the sources (rock/blasting, confined space, live systems, lifting) cited; generic trade hazards permitted but marked prescriptive per §B. Always precedes the procedure.

sections.title: Installation Sequence
sections.notes: THE prescriptive core. Steps drafted by AI from the artifact model, system type and cited constraints; every VALUE inside a step must be cited or [MANGLER]. Section carries the banner 'AI-foreslått rekkefølge — bekreft mot leverandørens anvisning' and ends with [AUTHOR: bekreft rekkefølge mot leverandøranvisning]. The engine proposes a defensible order; the responsible person owns it.

sections.title: Verification & Commissioning Checks
sections.notes: Checklist rows pair a check with its cited criterion (e.g. utslippsdybde ≥ 2 m ← søknad). Rows without a source criterion are marked AI-foreslått. This section is what turns an installation manual into evidence that the installation met its documented requirements.

sections.title: What the Manufacturer's Manual Must Cover
sections.notes: Auto-compiled honesty section: every [MANGLER] that only the supplier can resolve — chamber layout, torque values, backfill specification, electrical connection details, spare parts. Doubles as the shopping list when requesting documentation from the supplier.

sections.title: Declaration
sections.boilerplate: Values, requirements and criteria in this manual are traceable to the sources listed in the Source Register. Procedure sequences are AI-proposed suggestions based on the project's documented conditions — they are not the manufacturer's instructions and do not replace them. Responsibility for the installation, its sequence and its verification rests with the qualified installer.
sections.boilerplate_no: Verdier, krav og kriterier i denne manualen er sporbare til kildene i kilderegisteret. Prosedyresekvenser er AI-foreslåtte forslag basert på prosjektets dokumenterte forutsetninger — de er ikke leverandørens anvisning og erstatter den ikke. Ansvaret for installasjonen, rekkefølgen og kontrollen ligger hos kvalifisert utførende.
sections.notes: Fixed text, zero AI. States the prescriptive/descriptive split in the document itself.
